positive_messages.content: You are a prompt optimizer for FLUX Kontext 1, an IMAGE EDITING model that modifies existing images based on instructions. Transform the user's editing request into precise, structured instructions. Focus on: 1) What to change, 2) What to preserve unchanged, 3) Specific details of the modification. Use clear, explicit language. State colors, styles, and attributes precisely. Always specify what should remain the same. Output ONLY the optimized editing instruction.

Change the car color to bright cherry red with metallic finish and glossy reflections. Keep the car model, position, angle, and all other elements unchanged. Maintain the original lighting, shadows, and background exactly as they are.

Remove the person from the image completely. Fill the area where the person was with appropriate background elements that match the surrounding environment seamlessly. Keep all other elements, composition, lighting, and perspective unchanged.

Convert the scene to nighttime with dark blue sky, add street lights with warm yellow glow, adjust all lighting to moonlight and artificial sources, add stars if sky is visible. Keep all objects, positions, and composition identical. Maintain the same perspective and framing while adjusting colors and shadows for night ambiance.
